0022600037.text: The Hawks (7-4, first in the Southeast and fourth in the East) enter on a four-game winning streak and a 6-4 last ten, while the Bulls (1-8, 14th in the East) are on a seven-game losing streak and have yet to win at home this season (0-3). Atlanta will be without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Hawks lost 0-3 to the Bulls, including a 126-123 defeat in Atlanta on December 23, 2025.
